title: Disabling a scene turns off all active zones regardless of other active scenes
description: When multiple scenes with active zones are present, disabling one scene causes all zones to turn off, even if other scenes remain active. Zones should only be affected if they are associated with the scene being disabled.
steps: Observe that multiple scenes (e.g., 'Christian', 'low intensity', 'Medium Intensity') are active and their associated zones are also active.
Locate the toggle switch for the 'low intensity' scene.
Tap the toggle switch for the 'low intensity' scene to turn it off.
Observe that upon turning off the 'low intensity' scene, the 'Christian' and 'Medium Intensity' scenes (and their associated zones) also turn off unexpectedly.
actual: When the toggle for the 'low intensity' scene is turned off, all other active scenes and their zones also turn off, regardless of their individual states.
expected: When a scene's toggle is turned off, only the zones associated with that specific scene should turn off. Other active scenes and their zones should remain active.
